# Details! damage meter — Rob's profile export
#
# Captured 11 Aug 2026 from Rob's live client (12.0.7), to be offered from
# Midnight Helper the way the bar preset is: something a player can apply
# instead of building it themselves.
#
# NOT WIRED UP YET. This file is storage, not a feature. Rob asked to keep the
# string safe first; the module under Addons/ comes later.
#
# WHAT IT IS
#   Details' own profile format. The `D!ProfileV2-` prefix, then LibDeflate-
#   compressed data. Details itself decodes it — we never parse this, we hand
#   it over whole.
#
# WHAT STILL HAS TO BE ANSWERED BEFORE BUILDING ANYTHING
#   1. Can an addon hand Details a profile string directly, or does the player
#      have to paste it into Details' own import window? Only Details' API can
#      say; do not assume the first because it would be convenient.
#   2. Is the string tied to a Details version the way our Edit Mode string is
#      tied to a patch? If so it needs re-exporting when Details updates, and
#      the offer needs the same version warning the bar preset carries.
#   3. Does importing replace ALL of somebody's Details profiles or add one?
#      Replacing someone's damage meter setup uninvited is not a trade we get
#      to make — see the bar preset, which backs up first and can be undone.
#
# Until those three are measured, this file is a note to self with a payload.

D!ProfileV2-
